annotations.title: Daily Digest and Week in Review

description: Mappit's editions: the Daily Digest (the day's top stories worldwide, as emailed to subscribers) and the weekly Week in Review (an analysis of the week's biggest storylines). Omit date and slug for the latest; set list to true for the archive.

date.description: For a daily digest: its date, like "2026-09-28".

list.description: true for the archive (newest first) instead of one edition.

slug.description: For a Week in Review: its slug, exactly as the list returned it.
